title: SG-4.1.1 · Pin phaser in package.json to 3.90.x
summary: Replace the phaser ^4.2.1 range in game/frontend/package.json with an exact or tilde 3.90.x version.
description: Context: game/frontend/package.json line 18 declares "phaser": "^4.2.1", which resolves to Phaser 4.x. The StoryForge goal requires Phaser 3.90. Desired behavior: the dependency is an exact or tilde 3.90.x version with no caret range. Expected result: package.json can only resolve to 3.90.x. Why: the engine code is written against the Phaser 3.90 API. Lockfile regeneration is a separate sub-goal and is not part of this ticket.
acceptance_criteria: Given game/frontend/package.json, when dependencies.phaser is read, then it matches ^(~)?3\.90\.\d+ with no caret.
Given the phaser value, when it is evaluated, then it cannot resolve to any 4.x version.

in_scope: The phaser entry in game/frontend/package.json dependencies
preserve: All other dependency entries and the scripts block in package.json

technical_constraints: Value must be exact (3.90.0) or tilde (~3.90.0); no caret range
definition_of_done: Unit test on the declaration passes
